description: On the bed in front of the hands there’s a small red padlock with its shackle open and a tiny pink key lying nearby. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up and steady the padlock, bringing it toward the left hand; the left hand grips the metal shackle while the right hand nudges and twists the lock body as if aligning and locking or unlocking it, then the right hand lets go and leaves the padlock and key resting on the sheet.
